Coated Paper & Flexible Packaging, Made in India

KP Packaging is a Mumbai based manufacturer and distributor of coated papers and flexible packaging with over 30 years of experience. The company runs extrusion coating and lamination machines from Korea, China and the United States of America at its plant in Silvassa, India, and supplies pharmaceutical, food & beverage, FMCG and medical/surgical packaging to around 500 clients across about 25 countries.

Two Verticals, One Promise

Packaging you can rely on

Areas of Expertise

We coat and laminate on various grades of paper, paperboard, cupstock, polyester film, BOPP film, aluminium foils and fabrics. Our products pack medicines, gloves, yeast, sugar, salt, pepper, paper cups, boxes and tea. Our aluminium foil, plain and printed, pairs with rigid and flexible PVC films for blister and strip packing, condom laminates, surgical suture laminates and ORS salts. We also produce a full range of flexible packaging for chips, tea, coffee, salt, noodles, chocolates, detergents, soaps, oils and snacks.

Extrusion Coating & Lamination

Poly (LDPE) coating on printed and unprinted paper, board and aluminium foil.

Rotogravure Printing

High resolution 8 colour gravure printing for sharp, durable, on brand packaging.

Slitting & Rewinding

Multiple slitting, sheeting and rewinding machines for precise reel widths to customer specifications.

Paper Distribution

Authorized distributor for leading Indian paper mills across a broad grade range.

Frequently Asked Questions

What does KP Packaging do?
KP Packaging manufactures extrusion coated paper laminates and distributes a wide range of mill grade papers for primary and flexible packaging, serving the pharmaceutical, food & beverage, FMCG and medical/surgical industries.
Where is KP Packaging located?
Its corporate office is in Lower Parel, Mumbai, Maharashtra, and its manufacturing plant is in Silvassa, Dadra and Nagar Haveli, India.
How do I request a quote from KP Packaging?
Contact the corporate office at prem@kppackaging.com or +91 85916 56966, the plant at sales@kppackaging.com or +91 85916 94328, or use the inquiry form on kppackaging.com.
Is KP Packaging a manufacturer or a distributor?
Both. KP Packaging manufactures extrusion coated laminates in house and is also an authorized distributor for multiple Indian paper mills.
Does KP Packaging export internationally?
Yes. KP Packaging serves 500+ clients across more than 25 countries and is actively expanding its international business.
What papers does KP Packaging make?
KP Packaging supplies both coated and uncoated papers: glassine, MG poster, chromo, cupstock, MG kraft, 3 ply and 4 ply foil laminates, folding box board, duplex board, greaseproof, tissue, and medical Bactite and Grid Lacquer papers.
Is KP Packaging's paper food safe and pharma grade?
Yes. It supplies FDA and FSC aligned glassine and barrier papers for pharmaceuticals and food safe cupstock and greaseproof papers for food and beverage packaging.
